Metadata.title: GPS coordinates
Metadata.description: Read the current latitude and longitude on a device with GPS. Without GPS, coordinates cannot be obtained.

HomePage.title: Read the current coordinates
HomePage.lead: Satellite positioning only. Accuracy must be within {meters, number} meters. Network estimates and devices without GPS will not return coordinates.
HomePage.stepPermission: The browser asks for location permission after you tap
HomePage.stepOutdoors: Open sky makes it easier to lock onto satellites
HomePage.stepLocal: Coordinates stay on this device and can be copied
HomePage.footer: System location permission is required. Indoors or between tall buildings, satellites may not lock right away.

GpsPanel.heading: Current position
GpsPanel.checking: Checking whether this device can provide a location…
GpsPanel.locating: Reading the satellite position. A recent satellite fix appears immediately. Outdoors this usually takes a few seconds.
GpsPanel.noGps: Unavailable. This device has no GPS.
GpsPanel.unsupported: This browser does not provide a location API.
GpsPanel.inaccurate: No GPS fix within {meters, number} meters was received.
GpsPanel.denied: The browser denied location permission. Allow this site to use your location, then try again.
GpsPanel.insecure: Location is only available over HTTPS or on localhost. Open this page over a secure connection.
GpsPanel.idle: Ready. Computers without GPS usually cannot reach an accuracy of {meters, number} meters.
GpsPanel.copyFailed: Copy failed. Long-press the coordinates to copy them manually.
